newsitem.title: GERMANY: Loesch to meet profit, sales forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Loesch to meet profit, sales forecasts.

text.p: German waste disposal company Loesch Umweltschutz AG said on Wednesday it would fully meet the profit and sales forecasts it made on flotation in September.

"We will comprehensively fulfil the sales and earnings forecasts we made at the time of our flotation in September in the light of current performance," said chairman Dietrich-Otto Panteleit in a compulsory statement.

"If similar conditions continue in the fourth quarter, our group sales forecast of 235 million marks and our outlook for profit from ordinary activities of 18.2 million marks could be exceeded," said Panteleit.
Loesch said new German legislation for the waste disposal market would also have a positive effect.
In September Loesch issued two million five-mark shares at 25 marks per share in an initial public offering and was listed on the Frankfurt stock exchange.
